purpose: Define, before any candidate is run, the exact metrics and failure conditions by which masking candidates are judged. No metric may be added or relaxed after seeing candidate results.
no_model_performance_input: No JEPA loss, accuracy, downstream biological score, disease outcome or published CorrMask benchmark number may be used to select the policy. The CorrMask literature motivates evaluating a HYBRID family; it does not select it.
dependency_is_not_biology: Every edge produced in this lane is a statistical dependency under a declared estimator. It is not a causal or biological claim.

authority_scope_finding.question: does the masking authority own the numeric mask fraction?
authority_scope_finding.evidence: MaskingAuthorityV1 carries dependency_source_authority_id, a random/structural mixture ratio, and REFERENCES to a separate target_evidence_budget_authority_id and rng_authority_id.
authority_scope_finding.consequence: this lane freezes dependency semantics and the structural/random mixture ratio only. It must NOT freeze a mask fraction, block count, or evidence budget; those belong to the target-evidence-budget and schedule/runtime authorities.

estimator_family_declared_before_executi.statistic: within-donor Spearman rank correlation between address pairs, computed per donor on that donor's own cells
estimator_family_declared_before_executi.why_rank: robust to per-address scale and to depth-driven magnitude differences across technologies
estimator_family_declared_before_executi.why_within_donor: a pooled FULL104 coefficient can be dominated by source, operator, donor and composition differences; within-donor estimation removes between-donor mean structure by construction
estimator_family_declared_before_executi.recurrence_rule: an ordered pair (a -> b) is a candidate edge iff b appears in a's top-K within-donor neighbour list in at least R of the evaluable donor strata
estimator_family_declared_before_executi.balancing: each donor contributes exactly one vote regardless of its cell count; each source's donor votes are additionally renormalised so a source cannot gain authority merely by having more donors or more cells
estimator_family_declared_before_executi.missing_support: a pair is EVALUABLE in a stratum only where both addresses are measurable there. Non-evaluable is missing evidence, never disagreement and never a negative vote.
forbidden_inputs: common-core membership as evidence of importance

tie_breaking_rule: If two candidate configurations are indistinguishable on the primary metric within its declared tolerance, prefer, in order: (1) lower mask burden, (2) higher target coverage, (3) lower source/operator leakage delta, (4) lower max component size, (5) lexicographically smaller (K, R, S). Never prefer by model performance.

A_dependency_recurrence.definition: fraction of candidate edges surviving the recurrence rule across evaluable donor strata
A_dependency_recurrence.failure_condition: if no (K,R) cell yields any edge set with recurrence above chance on the permutation null, the family FAILS

B_cross_source_recurrence.definition: for edges whose pair is jointly measurable in >=2 sources, fraction recurring in >=S sources
B_cross_source_recurrence.unmeasured_handling: excluded from both numerator and denominator; reported as NOT_ESTIMABLE
B_cross_source_recurrence.failure_condition: reporting invariance where a technology cannot measure the pair

definitions: neighbour-set Jaccard between disjoint donor halves
sign agreement of the within-donor coefficient across strata
rank recurrence of the top-K list
C_stability.failure_condition: median split-half Jaccard not exceeding the permuted-label null

D_anti_interpolation_exposure.definition: correlated_partner_exposure(mask, edges) from masking_audit_metrics_v1 -- the fraction of dependency edges with exactly one endpoint hidden
D_anti_interpolation_exposure.comparison: dependency-aware candidate vs uniform baseline at COMPARABLE MASK BURDEN (matched within 2 percentage points of masked fraction)
D_anti_interpolation_exposure.qualification_threshold: candidate must reduce exposure by at least 20 percent relative to the uniform baseline at matched burden
D_anti_interpolation_exposure.threshold_justification: declared prospectively as a CONVENTION; it is a structural mask-geometry effect size, not tuned to any observed value and not derived from model performance

E_coverage.definition: fraction of lawful target addresses receiving a valid mask construction
E_coverage.failure_condition: coverage below 0.95 for any source, or any silent drop of difficult targets

definitions: largest connected component of the co-mask graph
F_mask_burden.failure_condition: largest co-mask component exceeding 5 percent of measurable support for any target, or context retention falling below 0.5 of measurable support

G_source_operator_leakage.definition: balanced-accuracy delta for predicting source and operator from (support pattern) vs (support pattern + generated mask pattern), donor-held-out, simple linear probe
G_source_operator_leakage.threshold_justification: CONVENTION declared prospectively; chosen as a small absolute effect, not from observed results

H_hidden_target_independence.definition: permuting hidden target scalars while holding target identity and support fixed must leave the mask bit-identical

I_replay.definition: deterministic_mask_digest identical for the same authority, registry, support state and RNG state

J_eligibility.definition: target eligibility resolved from the current support/estimability authority only
J_eligibility.failure_condition: eligibility depending on expression magnitude, QC, or any post-hoc statistic

estimator_must_pass_before_real_data.note: the dependency estimator is qualified on synthetic fixtures with known ground truth BEFORE it touches FULL104
fixtures: independent addresses -> no dependency structure recovered
donor-only effect -> must NOT become within-cell molecular dependence
operator-only effect -> must NOT manufacture neighbour structure
source-only effect -> must NOT become a universal dependency
shared missing-support pattern -> must NOT become an edge
unequal source sample size -> large source must NOT dominate
estimator_must_pass_before_real_data.rule: if the estimator fails any fixture, fix the estimator before any real FULL104 dependency analysis

candidates_declared_before_execution.U: uniform/random baseline at matched burden -- reference, never automatically authority
candidates_declared_before_execution.H: historical Pearson/top-K graph comparator -- HISTORICAL_COMPARATOR_ONLY, thresholds carry zero current authority
candidates_declared_before_execution.HY: conservative hybrid: recurrent donor evidence + cross-source agreement where observable + deterministic fallback where consensus evidence is unavailable. DEFINED NOW, before any outcome inspection, so that selecting it later is not post-hoc.

fallback_for_native_support_declared_now: Targets whose pairs are not jointly measurable across sources are NOT declared private biology and are NOT dropped. They fall back, in order: (1) donor-recurrent evidence within measurable strata if that qualifies, (2) deterministic conservative expansion over the measurable support, (3) uniform masking. Coverage is reported separately for this population.
global_failure_conditions: no candidate family satisfies D at matched burden -> report MASKING_AUTHORITY_REMAINS_OPEN
estimator fails any synthetic fixture and cannot be repaired -> report failure, do not proceed to real data
any metric is added, removed or relaxed after seeing candidate results -> the lane is void
a test that executes zero eligible targets or pairs is a FAILURE, not a pass
insufficient comparable support in a source -> NOT_ESTIMABLE, never PASS
